title: Normal ChIP H3K9ac Control in Primary Human Hepatocytes
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells and quench
steps.instruction: Fix 1 × 10⁶ isolated primary human hepatocytes in 1 % formaldehyde for 14 minutes, then quench by adding glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate an additional 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash cells and harvest
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, cat 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat 303410), then scrape the cells from the plates to harvest them.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Lyse the harvested cells and isolate nuclei using a Covaris E220 sonicator set to 75 W peak power, 2 % duty factor, 200 cycles/burst for 4.5 minutes.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: Perform ChIP as described by Arrigoni 2018, omitting barcode ligation and pooling; for each immunoprecipitation use 2 µg of antibody bound to protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, cat 88802) with an equal amount of chromatin per sample.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin by Nanodrop
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the input chromatin using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Quantify IP DNA by Qubit
steps.instruction: Determine the amount of immunoprecipitated DNA with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England Biolabs, cat E7645S).

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate library size distribution and concentration with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
